fusions.name: Muted Cluck
fusions.desc: Clucks a bolt that hits the first enemy in its path for 8 damage, knocks it back 2 tiles and leaves it [Suppressed] for 3 seconds, its abilities out of reach.

fusions.name: Hen-Scrawl Rune
fusions.desc: Scratches a rune into the target for 28 damage and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 6 seconds. If it hits, every ally strikes 20% harder for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Long Reach
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further.

fusions.name: Rote Repetition
fusions.desc: Your abilities' cooldowns are 8% shorter. Your armour rises by 5%.
